# Testing PowerShell with Pester Guidelines

- These guidelines apply to Pester test files.
- Pester test files end with .Tests.ps1
- Pester data for test files end with .DataForTests.ps1
- The validation string for DataForTests.ps1 is "D4T validation passed". When instructed to put the validation string into a data for tests file, place it as a coment at the top of the file if it doesn't exist.
